title: Installing a Dishwasher: Plumbing, Tailpiece, and Electrical Hookup (This Old House)

locations.name: basement
locations.basis: Transcript: 'water shut off down in the basement' indicates a plumbing access point location.

locations.name: kitchen
locations.basis: Transcript references 'kitchen sink' supply and that work occurs in a kitchen context; considered inference about the general work area.

summary: This instructional video guides a hands-on installation of a dishwasher, focusing on plumbing and electrical connections. The host demonstrates upgrading the hot-water supply with a dual-branch shut-off valve, performing copper-pipe compression fittings with ferrules, replacing the sink tailpiece with a dishwasher-tailpiece, and routing a stainless braided supply line. The segment also covers an electrical hookup via a polarized appliance plug, including how to identify hot and neutral, and ends with securing the unit, leveling, leak testing, and powering it up to verify operation. The steps combine practical carpentry, basic plumbing cartridges, and electrical safety checks typical of in-kitchen appliance installs.
topics: identifying hot vs neutral (smooth vs ribbed)
securing dishwasher to underside and leveling
safe routing to prevent backflow from sink

sections.title: Install dual-branch hot-water shut-off valve
sections.description: Replace the existing hot-water shut-off with a dual-branch valve to feed both the sink and the dishwasher; sets up future serviceability and prevents backflow by isolating each fixture.

sections.title: Explain fittings and prepare for braided supply
sections.description: Discuss how compression fittings seal copper pipe with ferrules, note reuse of the existing nut and ferrule, and introduce the stainless braided dishwasher supply hose that will connect to the valve.

sections.title: Replace tailpiece with dishwasher-tailpiece
sections.description: Remove the sink tailpiece and install the dishwasher-tailpiece with the appropriate top gasket and bottom nut with integrated gasket to accept the dishwasher discharge.

sections.title: Connect dishwasher water line to valve and prepare threads
sections.description: Attach the dishwasher’s water line to the new valve using the adapter elbow and teflon tape, ensuring the threads are clean and aligned so the connection seals properly.

sections.title: Electrical hookup basics for the dishwasher
sections.description: Identify hot and neutral in the polarized appliance plug by smooth vs ribbed sides, connect to the corresponding wires, and verify proper grounding before proceeding.

sections.title: Route water line, install, and secure dishwasher
sections.description: Route the water line under the narrow groove, slide the dishwasher into place, secure to the underside, and protect the line to prevent backflow or damage.

sections.title: Leak testing and power-up verification
sections.description: Test for leaks after reconnecting water and electricity, plug in and power on the dishwasher, and verify normal operation through a test run.
